MINUTES OF AN ADJOURNED MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  LA VERNE
  Monday, June 6, 2022

1.  An adjourned meeting of the La Verne City Council was called to order by Mayor Hepburn at 4: 30 p. m.
2.  Council  Members  present:  Mayor Tim Hepburn
  Mayor Pro Tem Muir Davis
  Council Member Robin Carder
  Council Member Wendy Lau
  Council Member Rick Crosby

  Absent:  None.

  Advisory personnel  present:  City Manager Robert Russi
  Assistant to the City Manager JR Ranells
  City Attorney Robert L. Kress
  Assistant City Clerk Lupe Gaeta Estrella
  Community Development Director Eric Scherer
  Finance Director Marla Pendleton
  Police Chief Colleen Flores
  Fire Chief Chris Nigg
  Public Works Director Shawn Igoe

3.  Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Hepburn.

4.  2022- 23 City Budget  City Manager Russi reported that the purpose of this adjourned meeting was
  for the La Verne City Council to meet in a study session for Council to review
  and conceptually approve the 2022- 23 budget and also to allow public input.
  City Manager Russi presented the 2022- 23 Fiscal Year City Budget in the
  amount of $ 71,  282, 237  with  a power  point presentation.  He reported on some

  of the proposed changes to the budget which was adding a new Deputy Fire
  Chief, a new Accountant position, hiring a grant writing services firm, the
  Police Department will be acquiring a new camera license plate reader system,
  and  the repairs to Aquatic Center.  He stated that the budget is balanced and
  the General Fund Reserve is expected  to be $ 11. 8 million,  the highest level
  ever reached in the City of La Verne. He thanked all the Departments Heads,
  especially Finance Director Pendleton and Accountant Ulysses Reynoso for
  putting in extra hours in preparing the budget.

  Presentation of City  Assistant to the City Manager JR Ranells reported on the budgets for General
  Personnel & Risk
  Departmental Budgets  Administration, the City Manager' s Department , ( Includes
  Management, Finance, City Clerk and Information Systems),
  Budget Sections

  2- 3.

  Community Development  Community Development Director Scherer reported on the Community
  Department Budget  Development Department Budget, Budget Sections 3- 4.
  Presentation

  Fire Department  Budget  Fire Chief Nigg reported on the Fire Department Budget, Budget Section 5.
  Presentation
   City Council Minutes, adjourned Meeting, Monday, June 6, 2022, Page 2.

  Police Department Budget  Police Chief Colleen Flores reported on the Police Department Budget,
  Presentation  Budget Section 6.

  Community Services  City Manager Russi reported on the Community Services Department budget,
  Department  Budget  on behalf of Community Services Director Yvonne Duran who was unable to
  Presentation  attend the meeting, Budget Section 7.

  Public Works Department  Public Works Department Director Shawn Igoe reported on the Public Works
  Budget Presentation  Department( Includes Water, Streets, Fleet Maintenance, Building
  Maintenance & Parks), Budget Section 8.

  Overview of Major Capital  Public Works Director Shawn Igoe gave an Overview of Major Capital
  Improvements,  Capital  Improvements, Capital Equipment Outlay and Special Programs, Budget
  Equipment and Special  Sections 9- 10.
  Programs

  Mayor Hepburn called for public comment on this matter.

  There were  public comments. (  To hear what was said during public comment,
  please visit the City' s website to view the archived Council meeting.)

  City Manager Russi responded to questions asked during public comment.
  The City Council thanked all the Department Heads, especially the Finance
  Department and the City Manager' s leadership in managing and preparing the
  budget.  The City Council conceptually approved the La Verne City budget. A
  Resolution for the formal approval of the City budget will be scheduled for the
  June 20, 2022, City Council Meeting.

5.  Adjournment at 6: 13 p. m.

  Respectfully submitted,

  C.  c.  C  J
  Lu P e  Ga  ta Estrella, CMC
  Assistant  City Clerk
